perfecto-vs-pasado.instruction: Leé el texto sobre los viajes de Nico y respondé las preguntas eligiendo entre present perfect y pasado simple.
perfecto-vs-pasado.text:
Nico has traveled to many places in Argentina. He has been to Mendoza, Bariloche and Salta. Last year, he went to Mendoza with his sister to visit the wineries. They stayed there for five days and tried a lot of delicious food.

Nico has never been to Ushuaia, but he wants to go next winter. His friend Pablo has already been there twice. Pablo went in 2021 and again in 2023, and he loved it both times.

Yesterday, Nico bought a new backpack for his next trip. He hasn't decided where to go yet, but he has already started saving money. He thinks traveling is the best way to learn about new cultures.

options: No, he has never been there.
Yes, he has been there twice.
questions.explanation: 'Has never been' está en present perfect porque habla de una experiencia sin momento definido, es decir, en toda su vida hasta ahora.

questions.prompt: When did Nico go to Mendoza?
questions.explanation: 'Last year' es un momento definido y terminado, por eso se usa pasado simple: 'he went'.
'Yesterday' indica un momento específico del pasado, por eso la acción va en pasado simple: 'bought'.

perfecto-vs-pasado.text:
Carla has worked in marketing for eight years. She has worked for three different companies, but she has never worked abroad. Last month, she applied for a new job at a company in Buenos Aires.

She had an interview on Tuesday. The interviewer asked her many questions about her experience. Carla has already managed several big projects, so she talked about them with confidence.

She hasn't received an answer yet, but she is still waiting. Yesterday, she called the company to ask about the result, but nobody answered. Her friend Marcos has also applied for a job this month, and he already got an offer.
